title: Before a question is posted to the owner, its Departs from line is searched against roadmap/rulings
why: Incident (coordinator 15:17 CST Nov 14, its own miss; n=1; second of the day with item 839): the coordinator wrote the #3418 question as "main refuses a closed item, #3418 allows it" without searching the owner's rulings; own-748-b-rule-4 (13:20 CST Nov 13) and own-753-a-relayed-grant-entry (18:24 CST Nov 13) already let a routed closed item count, and #3224 and #3308 implement them. Triage posted the item with those rulings found and noted, and rewrote it in place on the coordinator's correction. Guard (the coordinator's proposal): before a question is posted, its Departs from line is searched against roadmap/rulings (and the ruling ids it names are read). Kin: departs-claim-read-from-code (the Departs from line about what main does is read from main's files). Rule: building-mistake-names-its-guard; the standing triage rule "check past rulings before posting an owner item". First act of a lane: find where an item is written (skill waiting-page, hooks/question_form.py) and where rulings are read, then red then green: an item whose Departs from line names a topic with a ruling on it carries that ruling under Based on (ruling), or the post is refused with the ruling id.
note: Filed 15:17 CST Nov 14 by triage. Tracker: the coordinator. Not started.
